cards.t: Samsung Wallet Integrates USDC on Solana
cards.b: Samsung is integrating USDC transfers via Solana into Samsung Wallet for 82 million US Galaxy users, enabling cross-border remittances and payouts to bank accounts in over 60 countries starting in late October.

per.USDC: Integration into 82 million Galaxy devices drives massive real-world stablecoin distribution.
per.SOL: Solana serves as the underlying blockchain powering Samsung Wallet's USDC cross-border transfer capabilities.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact day in late October for the roll-out

cards.b: Layer-1 blockchain Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol allowing holders to use bitcoin as collateral without moving it off the Bitcoin network, backed by over $500 million in commitments ahead of mainnet launch.

per.SUI: The Hashi protocol launch with $500 million in commitments expands institutional utility for the Sui ecosystem.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact launch date for Hashi mainnet

cards.t: Tether Partners with Kazakhstan Central Bank
cards.b: Tether signed a deal with Kazakhstan's central bank to help study a tenge-pegged stablecoin and bring real-world assets onto a blockchain.

per.USDT: Collaboration with a central bank expands institutional validation for Tether and its underlying technology.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Timeline for pilot rollout or stablecoin issuance

cards.b: Solana is completing a seven-week push to halve its block times as its final 200-millisecond upgrade nears completion, though validators face higher costs and tighter operating windows.

per.SOL: Achieving 200-millisecond block times enhances Solana's network performance and transaction speed.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact completion date of the final upgrade
